affected_predicate.description: An SMS reminder containing the awaiting-shipment product name and order number, with no other text, is sent to the recipient.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, steps 7 and 8 clicked the order-details screen and left it visibly unchanged while claiming progress toward or initiation of an SMS reminder; no SMS interface or sending transition was observed.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the exposed claim that SMS initiation had occurred was explicitly adopted. Step 9 then issued an answer containing the product name and order number and asserted that the SMS was sent, while the order-details screen remained unchanged. No SMS composition, recipient handoff, or send action is visible. Because step 9 is also the last observable step, this false-completion mechanism remains uncorrected through the trace.

summary: The single frozen chain shows explicit reuse of an unsupported SMS-initiation claim followed by a terminal answer action that falsely treats the SMS subgoal as completed. The observable trace contains no SMS interface or send transition and no subsequent recovery.
